metrics.name: Store Health Probes: Posix Unhealthy
metrics.expr: sum(increase(ucm:posix_unhealthy_count_total{model_name="$model_name", job=~"$job", instance="$instance", engine=~"$engine", worker_rank=~"$worker_rank"}[$__rate_interval]))
